Jessica Schuster Design is seeking a talented and highly organized Architectural Designer to join our New York–based studio.
Responsibilities
Proficiency in developing and coordinating interior architectural drawing sets, including floor plans, RCPs, interior elevations, sections, millwork drawings, and architectural details
Ability to translate design direction from Principal and Senior Designers into accurate, detailed technical documentation
Strong understanding of interior architectural detailing, construction methods, materials, and assemblies, particularly for high-end residential interiors
Experience detailing custom millwork, paneling, doors, stonework, specialty architectural elements and custom furniture
Experience preparing and coordinating architectural schedules, including finishes, plumbing fixtures, architectural and decorative hardware, lighting, doors, and other interior architectural elements
Ability to coordinate product specifications, dimensions, finishes, and installation requirements with architectural drawings and consultant documentation
Experience coordinating architectural documentation with architects, contractors, fabricators, and specialty consultants.
Ability to review architectural and consultant drawings for consistency with approved interior design direction
Experience reviewing millwork shop drawings, fabrication drawings, and submittals for design intent, dimensional accuracy, materials, and detailing
Ability to identify and resolve drawing discrepancies, and technical coordination issues.
Familiarity with RFIs, submittals, and construction administration
Ability to support preparation of client presentations
Proficiency in developing and maintaining SketchUp models for interior architectural design and documentation
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Architecture or Interior Architecture
3–5 years of professional experience, preferably within a high-end residential interior design or architecture studio
Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, and Google Workspace required
Experience with Revit, Rhino, Studio Designer, or similar design and project management software is a plus
Strong technical drafting and detailing skills with a thorough understanding of architectural drawing conventions
Familiarity with residential construction practices and coordination with architects of record
Excellent communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with senior design team members
Strong design sensibility with an appreciation for bespoke, high-end residential interiors, craftsmanship, materials, and architectural detailing
The Ideal Candidate
You have a refined eye, strong technical instincts, and a genuine enthusiasm for interiors, architecture, furniture, art, and design history. You understand that exceptional residential design lives in the details—from the proportion of a millwork elevation to the trim on an upholstered chair—and enjoy being involved in every stage of bringing a project to life.
You are proactive, resourceful, collaborative, and meticulous, with the ability to take ownership of your work while responding thoughtfully to creative direction. You are highly skilled in technical drafting and documentation, with the ability to translate design concepts into thoughtful, precise, and well-coordinated drawings.
If you are a highly motivated, detail-oriented individual with a passion for creating exceptional interior spaces, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your résumé and portfolio to [email protected] with the subject line: “JSD Architectural Designer.” Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be considered.
